title: Design: Name error shows after clicking in and out
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom.
  • Open the attached design picture ct-p3-03-validation-errors.png at 100% zoom beside the screen.
  • Start on the Credit Terms page, Active tab.
  • If you cannot set up any of the above, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click "New Credit Term".
  2. Click in the Name box.
  3. Click the "Due day of the following month" option.
  4. Resize the browser window to 1536 px wide (for example, maximise it on a 1536 x 864 screen at 100% zoom).
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The "New Credit Term" window opens with no error.

Step 2:

  • The cursor is in the Name box and no error shows.

Step 3:

  • The Name box turns red with the red message "Enter a name." under it (design note: "Errors show only after a field is touched or Create is pressed").

Step 4:

  • At 1536 px nothing overlaps, nothing is cut off and nothing needs a sideways scroll.
  • The layout described above is unchanged, only wider.

Held: one reading of the design's note; under the PRD no Name error shows until the user has typed in it. Released or deleted when question 11 is answered (register CT-D04).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11672 (Story 3, Create or edit a credit term)

  • S3-R10: “The Name is checked only once the user has typed in it (then each time they leave the field) or presses Create / Save. Opening the window, or clicking an option or a box before typing a name, never shows a Name error.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Default Credit Terms" (https://claude.ai/artifact/2erYxWz2ffDNcoXzEfu6wf), read 23 Oct 2026: page "3 New credit term and Inactive tab" ("Validation errors"). Compare the screen with the pictures below; the expected results above come from the PRD quotes, except where this held design case follows the design.

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • ct-p3-03-validation-errors.png

The design's own words:

  • “Create Credit Term stays disabled until every field is valid. Errors show only after a field is touched or Create is pressed; the Name field is never red when the window opens.”
